measurement: M2: Codex's own prompt render with and without oh-my-codex 0.22.6; no model call, no sign-in
clone: one fresh standalone clone of the repository at main 9c5daaae9d32acf259f965fd7b95b458604503b6, the same path for both arms
command: CODEX_HOME="$H" codex --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust -C "$WT" -m gpt-6-astra -c model_reasoning_effort=high -c "projects={\"$WT\"={trust_level=\"trusted\"}}" debug prompt-input 'Reply with exactly the word OK. Do not run any command or call any tool.' </dev/null
script: 0008_m2.sh: `render` is what M2 ran, 3 times per arm; `split` and `roles` were written for the ADR and run on the saved renders

arms.b: a scratch CODEX_HOME filled by `omx setup --scope user --install-mode legacy --mcp none`, oh-my-codex 0.22.6 installed with --ignore-scripts; HOME, CODEX_HOME and the setup folder throwaway

counted: messages: UTF-8 bytes of every message text; tools: UTF-8 bytes of the tool declarations as compact JSON (jq tojson). Bytes, not tokens.
renders_note: Within each arm the counted parts are byte-identical (equal hashes); the raw files also differ in item ids and metadata. The raw renders stay outside the repository because they hold home-directory paths.

sections.section: AGENTS.md instructions (the repository's, plus $CODEX_HOME/AGENTS.md in arm b, 26,674 bytes)
JSON brackets and commas of the tool list

totals.delta_share: +60.6 % of arm a's render: a fresh session's first prompt, from an empty scratch home

role_list.where: spawn_agent's agent_type parameter in the collaboration group: absent in arm a; in arm b 5,001 bytes as JSON, 5,015 with its key and comma, which is the whole growth of the group
role_list.note: The source reconstruction counted OMX's 18 roles only (2,610 characters). Codex 0.167.2 lists its own 3 roles as well once user-defined roles exist, so the measured section is larger.

not_in_m2: the SessionStart hook text (358 characters reconstructed), which the render leaves out
model-reported input_tokens: M1 did not run in user scope (run 2 measured it in project scope; see 0008-results.json)
